faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sell for?
faq.a: 13 townhomes sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $824,000.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park?
faq.a: The median was 35 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 13 townhomes that sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park went for between $680,000 and $1,000,000, around a median of $824,000.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 13 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park?
faq.a: Of the 13 sales, 13 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $566.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park?
faq.a: The median year built was 1986 for the 13 townhomes sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park had 2 bedrooms, from the 13 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Crescent Beach and Ocean Park condos and townhomes for sale now
What Crescent Beach and Ocean Park condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

13 townhomes sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park with a median price of $824,000 (the middle half sold between $680,000 and $1,000,000), taking a median of 35 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $523 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median strata fee of $566 a month. 5 condos sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park with a median price of $1,035,000, taking a median of 64 days to sell at 92.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $556 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $907 a month.

blocks.text: How Crescent Beach and Ocean Park compares with the rest of South Surrey

The median townhome in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sold for $824,000, about the same as the South Surrey median of $835,900 across 413 sales. Crescent Beach and Ocean Park townhomes took a median 35 days to sell, against 26 days for South Surrey as a whole.
